name: Rust gRPC Reflection Dev + Git-Sync
postCreateCommand: git submodule update --init --recursive --depth 1 && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && curl -sSL https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/releases/download/v1.9.3/grpcurl_1.9.3_linux_x86_64.tar.gz | tar -xz -C ~/.local/bin grpcurl
postStartCommand: nohup sh -c 'while true; do cargo run; sleep 2; done' > /tmp/app.log 2>&1 &
